system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:57 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 recorded a network logon for sam.okafor from WS-SOKAFOR-01 (source IP 10.40.10.23).

At 13:42:01 UTC, PowerShell ran on WS-ICHEN-01 as NWD\sam.okafor using the exact UNC script path documented in the organization's workstation-patching practice. This is consistent with the reported approximate time and the authorized remote-patching workflow.

The PowerShell process connected through the proxy during a Windows Update Agent download; proxy and network records report approximately 38.8 MB received. It then launched wusa.exe to install a Windows update package quietly.
wusa.exe and the PowerShell process both terminated shortly afterward.

Separately, DC-NWD-01 made several connection attempts toward WS-ICHEN-01; the recorded attempts to ports 8080, 443, and 445 were rejected, while the port 135 record shows no completed connection. These records do not establish a link to the PowerShell activity, but merit separate validation.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the PowerShell command line and process lifecycle, but do not include the contents or hash of Apply-Updates.ps1.
The records do not show what the user saw on screen; process creation alone cannot confirm that a visible PowerShell window appeared.
The supplied evidence does not independently corroborate the administrative session from logs on WS-SOKAFOR-01.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish that Ivy Chen launched PowerShell; the recorded PowerShell process ran as sam.okafor.
The evidence does not establish whether the reported window was visible to Ivy Chen or whether its appearance was caused by this process.
The evidence does not establish the purpose or initiating process behind the DC-NWD-01 connection attempts toward WS-ICHEN-01.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the contents, hash, and execution or file-access audit trail for \\FILE-NWD-01\Admin\Apply-Updates.ps1 around 13:42 UTC.
Correlate the WS-SOKAFOR-01 administrative session and remote-execution records with the logon and process on WS-ICHEN-01.
Investigate DC-NWD-01 telemetry around 13:51 UTC to identify the process or activity responsible for the connection attempts toward WS-ICHEN-01.
